nobox.final_span:
These cars can be tested and showcased on roads that are closed to other traffic and approved by the DMV. Notable is the fact that BMW, Mercedes, and Volkswagen performed no official driving at all, especially in Mercedes’ case, since they are likely the furthest along among car companies in developing human-machine collaboration software, which serves as a precursor to a fully autonomous vehicle. Similarly, Ford created an entire division dedicated to HMC.
BMW only documented the distance their researchers walked on city sidewalks and some parking lots in California during testing of the car’s new software versions and sensors. The same applied to Honda, which recorded no California driving entries but a total of 750 miles in other states and approximately another 750 research miles in California, compared to the passenger miles driven with paying riders.
